title: BodyModel
description: Schema for a BodyModel compendium entry (Rpg/Compendium/BodyModel.cs). Describes the complete body of an entity: its stats, body part hierarchy, and entity-level features.

Expr.description: An expression: either a DSL string (leading '=', e.g. "= 1 + target.constitution"; see Rpg/Scripting/DOCS.md) or a literal (number, string, boolean, null, or an array of those).

PartStatModifier.description: A stat modifier provided by a body part, scaled by the part's current health ratio.

stat.description: ID of the stat to modify.

atFull.description: Number expression. Modifier value when the body part is at full health.

atZero.description: Number expression. Modifier value when the body part is at 0 health. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

standaloneHPOnly.description: If true, this modifier only applies when the part uses its own standalone HP pool.

operation.description: StatModifierType expression (one of: Flat, FlatPostMods, Percent, Multiplier, Capmax, Capmin, OverrideBase, OverrideFinal). How the modifier value is applied to the stat.

DamageModifier.description: A damage modifier applied to a specific damage type on a body part.

damageType.description: Name of the DamageType to modify.

operation.description: StatModifierType expression (one of: Flat, FlatPostMods, Percent, Multiplier, Capmax, Capmin, OverrideBase, OverrideFinal). How the modifier is applied.

BodyPartModel.description: A body part node in the body hierarchy.

name.description: Display name of the body part (e.g. 'Head', 'Left Arm').

group.description: Group category for this part (e.g. 'head', 'torso', 'arm'). Used for grouping in the UI and damage resolution.

maxHealth.description: Number expression. Maximum health points of this body part.

area.description: Number expression. Relative surface area used for hit-location probability. Higher area = more likely to be hit.

painMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to pain generated by injuries on this part. 1.0 = normal.

groupVital.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Whether this bodypart is vital for the group or not. If so, the group will be considered dead if this part is dead.

healthMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to each layer's MaxHealth on this body part. 1.0 = normal.

sensitivity.description: Multiplier applied to each layer's pain multiplier on this body part. Higher = more painful.

slots.description: Equipment slot identifiers available on this body part (e.g. 'hand', 'head').

providedStats.description: Stat modifiers provided to the entity owner by this whole body part (independent of layers).

damageModifiers.description: Damage type modifiers that apply when this part is hit.

skills.description: Skill compendium IDs granted to the entity while this part is present.

selfFeatures.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the BodyPart entity itself.

features.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the owning entity when this part is present.

stats.description: Base numeric stat values stored directly on this body part entity (keyed by stat ID).

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata for custom game logic or tooling. Not processed by the core engine.

children.description: Child body parts attached to this part (e.g. 'Hand' is a child of 'Arm').

postures.description: Optional body postures that can be assumed while this part is healthy enough. Postures provide movement and combat modifiers and can be used to implement crouching, crawling, etc.

restingPosture.description: The default posture assumed when the entity is at rest.

oneOf.description: Name of a layer profile defined in the top-level 'layerProfiles' map.
Inline layer profile definition. May use 'extends' to inherit from a named profile.

layersProfile.description: Layer profile for this body part. Either a string referencing a named profile, or an inline profile object.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Evaluated at build time to determine whether this body part is included. If false, the part and all its children are excluded from the final body.

StatDependency.description: Makes this stat's max or min depend on another stat's value.

value.description: Number expression. Evaluated to resolve the max/min value from the dependency.

operation.description: StatModifierType expression (one of: Flat, FlatPostMods, Percent, Multiplier, Capmax, Capmin, OverrideBase, OverrideFinal). How the dependency value is combined.

base.description: Number expression. Base value of the stat.

max.description: Number expression. Maximum cap. If omitted, no upper cap is enforced (unless overCap is false).

min.description: Number expression. Minimum cap. If omitted, no lower cap is enforced (unless underCap is false).

overCap.description: Whether the stat can exceed 'max'. Defaults to false (uncapped).

underCap.description: Whether the stat can go below 'min'. Defaults to false (uncapped).

aliases.description: Alternative IDs that can be used to reference this stat.

vital.description: If true, the entity dies (or similar) when this stat reaches its minimum.

local.description: If true, this stat is calculated only on each individual group, and does not represent something that runs through the whole body

regen.description: Number expression. Amount regenerated (or drained if negative) per tick. Omit for no passive regen.

dependsOn.description: Makes this stat's effective max or min depend on other stats. Keys are stat IDs, values can be a number (treated as a weight based on the ratio of the dependency stat, e.g: if the dependency is 75 and it's max is 100, and the weight is 1, this stat will have a -25% debuff) or an object containing a 'value' number expression and a 'type' StatModifierType expression. The dependency stat's value is always passed as $0

type.description: StatModifierType expression (one of: Flat, FlatPostMods, Percent, Multiplier, Capmax, Capmin, OverrideBase, OverrideFinal).

groupEffectiveness.description: Per-body-part-group effectiveness multiplier for this stat (keyed by group name, value 0–1+).

name.description: Optional human-readable display name for the stat.

onChange.description: Effect expression. Evaluated whenever this stat's value changes.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Evaluated against the entity's current state. If true, the threshold's effect is applied.

effect.description: Effect expression. Applied when the condition is met.

reverse.description: Effect expression. Optional effect to unapply when the condition is no longer met (e.g. if the stat goes back above a health threshold).

thresholds.description:
List of conditional effects that apply when the stat reaches certain thresholds.
$0 = Current stat value

BodyModel.description: Full body model for an entity.

name.description: Human-readable name of this body model (e.g. 'Human', 'Horse').

tags.description: List of tags that apply to this body model (e.g. 'humanoid', 'large', 'flying').

features.description: Feature compendium IDs applied to the entity that owns this body.

stats.description: Entity-level stats keyed by stat ID.

layerProfiles.description: Named layer profiles that can be referenced by body parts via 'layersProfile'. Keys are profile names.

onBuild.description:
Effects that are run when this body model is being built.
If this model has sexual dimorphism, the $0 variable will be set to true if the current body is female and false if it's male.

onHealthChange.description:
Effects that are run when any body part's health changes. 
$0 = BodyPart
$1 = CurrentHealth
$2 = OldHealth
$3 = InjurySeverity
$4 = InjuryType
Keep in mind the part can either have been healed or damaged.

postures.description: Optional body postures that can be assumed while this body is healthy enough. Postures provide movement and combat modifiers and can be used to implement crouching, crawling, etc.

restingPosture.description: The default posture assumed when the entity is at rest.

root.description: The root body part (typically 'Torso' or 'Body'). All other parts are children of this.

BodyLayerProfile.description: A layer profile defines the ordered set of tissue layers for body parts. Profiles can inherit from other profiles via 'extends'.

extends.description: Name of a parent profile to inherit from. This profile's layers are merged on top of the parent's.

order.description: Explicit ordering of layers from outermost to innermost. If omitted, inherits from parent or defaults to the keys of 'layers'.

layers.description: Layer definitions keyed by layer name (e.g. 'skin', 'fat', 'muscle', 'bone').

BodyLayerModel.description: A single tissue layer within a body part (e.g. skin, muscle, bone). Layers are ordered outermost to innermost and damage flows through them sequentially.

bloodFlow.description: Number expression. How much blood flows through this layer, affecting bleeding and healing rates.

maxHealth.description: Number expression. Maximum health of this layer.

regen.description: Number expression. How much injury severity is reduced per second due to natural healing.

onHeal.description: Effect expression. Executed when an injury on this layer is naturally healed (e.g. leave a scar).

pain.description: Number expression. Pain multiplier for injuries on this layer. Higher values mean more painful.

vital.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Whether this layer reaching 0 health instantly disables the body part (e.g. bone breakage).

bypass.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Evaluated per damage instance. If true, damage skips this layer entirely (goes straight to the next one without being reduced by modifiers or resistance).

oneOf.description: Simple format: keys are damage type names, values are percentage modifiers (e.g. 0.5 = 50% damage).
Full format: array of conditional damage modifier entries.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Controls when this modifier applies.

operation.description: StatModifierType expression (one of: Flat, FlatPostMods, Percent, Multiplier, Capmax, Capmin, OverrideBase, OverrideFinal). How the modifier is applied.

damageModifiers.description: Damage modifiers for this layer. Simple format: { "cut": 0.5 }. Full format: [{ "condition": ..., "value": ..., "operation": ... }].

oneOf.description: Simple format: keys are damage type names, values are penetration thresholds.
Full format: array of conditional resistance entries.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Controls when this resistance applies.

resistance.description: Penetration resistance for this layer. Damage above the threshold multiplied by maxHealth is passed on to the next layer. Simple format: { "cut": 1.25 }. Full format: [{ "condition": ..., "value": ... }]. Default is 0.5 (i.e. if the damage is above 50% of the layer's maxHealth, it penetrates to the next layer).

injuries.description: Pre-baked injuries applied to this layer at build time. Each entry has a type, severity, and optional condition.

providedStats.description: Stat modifiers provided to the entity owner, scaled by this layer's health ratio.

surfaceArea.description: Number expression. How much of the body part's surface area this layer covers. This is used to calculate how likely it is for an attack to hit this layer, and is used to calculate bypass chance. This is a value from 0 to 1, where 1 means the layer covers the entire body part and 0 means it doesn't cover any of it.

LayerInjuryModel.description: A pre-baked injury to apply to a layer at build time.

severity.description: Number expression. Severity of the injury.

condition.description: Condition (boolean) expression. Optional, evaluated at build time. If false, the injury is not added.
